entities.name: Query dermonecrotic toxin
observations: 275 aa sequence is an exact sequence match to UniProt C0JB21 from Loxosceles rufescens.
Belongs to the SPH domain family; Pfam SPH PF31089.1 spans residues 1–270.
Predicted molecular mass is 31.85 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.85.

entities.name: C0JB21
observations: Reviewed Loxosceles rufescens dermonecrotic toxin LruSicTox-alphaIV1; exact sequence match to the query.
Secreted Mg2+-binding phosphoric diester hydrolase/toxin; EC 4.6.1.-.
Catalyzes phosphodiester cleavage of sphingolipid and lysolipid substrates by transphosphatidylation, producing cyclic phosphate products plus choline or ethanolamine.

Curated reaction candidates include sphingomyelin to ceramide-1,3-cyclic phosphate plus choline; ceramide phosphoethanolamine to cyclic phosphate plus ethanolamine; lysophosphatidylcholine to lysophosphatidyl cyclic phosphate plus choline; and lysophosphatidylethanolamine to lysophosphatidyl cyclic phosphate plus ethanolamine.

entities.name: Sphingomyelin cyclic-phosphate cleavage
observations: N-(acyl)-sphingosylphosphocholine is converted to an N-(acyl)-sphingosyl-1,3-cyclic phosphate and choline.
This is a phosphodiester cleavage/transphosphatidylation reaction associated with Rhea RHEA:60652.

entities.name: Sphingolipid phosphoethanolamine cleavage
observations: N-(acyl)-sphingosylphosphoethanolamine is converted to an N-(acyl)-sphingosyl-1,3-cyclic phosphate and ethanolamine; Rhea RHEA:60648.
The enzyme can also act on lysophosphatidylcholine and lysophosphatidylethanolamine, yielding cyclic phosphate products and the corresponding headgroup alcohol.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: C0JB21 is annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; ChEBI CHEBI:18420.
